title: Mobile/touch: stage drawing & interaction does not work on touch devices
description:
## RESOLVED (agent-1275)

### Root cause
packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx — the stage work-area <div> bound ONLY
mouse events (onMouseDown/Move/Up/Leave) and had no touch-action. On a touch
device the browser never synthesizes the mouse drag sequence and instead claims
the finger gesture for native pan/zoom/scroll, so drawing/selection/drag never
fired. The handler bodies already take generic events and read clientX/clientY
via toStageCoords, so they were pointer-portable.

### Fix (StageArea.tsx only)
- workAreaStyle: added `touchAction: "none"` so the surface owns touch gestures.
- Replaced onMouseDown/Move/Up/Leave bindings on the work-area div with Pointer
  Events: onPointerDown -> setPointerCapture(pointerId) + onMouseDown;
  onPointerMove -> onMouseMove; onPointerUp -> releasePointerCapture + onMouseUp;
  onPointerCancel/onPointerLeave -> onMouseUp + cursor/button-state cleanup.
  Pointer Events unify mouse + pen + touch, so the existing tool logic now runs
  identically for touch. Pointer capture makes off-element drags robust (and the
  spec suppresses pointerleave mid-capture, so a drag continues off-element until
  release instead of aborting as the old mouseleave path did).
- toStageCoords is unchanged: a touch point's clientX/Y (via the unified pointer
  event) maps to the same stage coords as a mouse clientX/Y.

### Test
packages/authoring-ui/src/__tests__/touchStageCoords.test.ts (8 tests):
mouse/touch coordinate-mapping parity (same client point -> same stage coords),
center/zoom/pan mapping correctness, multi-segment drag-path parity, plus a
static source guard that the work-area binds onPointer* + sets touchAction:'none'
+ uses setPointerCapture.

### Verify
- pnpm --filter './packages/**' build : Done (all 7 packages, clean tsc)
- pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test --run : 50 files / 697 tests passed,
  0 failures (the documented ~3 task-1207 fixture failures did not occur).
